sources.title: Paper Reconstruction Evaluation: Evaluating Presentation and ...
sources.snippet: In this work, we introduce Paper Reconstruction Evaluation, the first systematic evaluation framework for AI-generated scientific papers. Along with PaperWrite-Bench, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the capabilities and risks of modern writing agents.
